items.briefing:
Cyber attacks rose 16% in July, with ransomware driving much of the increase — a timely reminder that Australian organisations remain firmly in the crosshairs. Staff should stay alert to suspicious emails or unusual system behaviour, as ransomware typically enters through phishing or compromised credentials.

On a positive note, Quest has achieved IRAP status, meaning it has met Australian government security standards for handling sensitive data — good news for organisations using Quest products in regulated environments.

**Practical tip:** Make sure your organisation's backups are tested regularly — a working backup is your best defence if ransomware strikes.

featured.title: Cyber attacks rise 16% as ransomware surges in July
featured.quote: Ransomware attacks surging 49% in July signals escalating threat to Australian organisations.
